# Huxiu fixture provenance

These files are byte-preserving captures of real Huxiu pages downloaded on
2026-09-12. They are not mock HTML.

- `channel.html`: `https://www.huxiu.com/article/`
- `001.html`: `https://www.huxiu.com/article/4890703.html`
- `002.html`: `https://www.huxiu.com/article/4890705.html`
- `003.html`: `https://www.huxiu.com/article/4890702.html`
- `004.html`: `https://www.huxiu.com/article/4890701.html`
- `005.html`: `https://www.huxiu.com/article/4890711.html`
- `006.html`: `https://www.huxiu.com/article/4890693.html`
- `007.html`: `https://www.huxiu.com/article/4890638.html`
- `008.html`: `https://www.huxiu.com/article/4890510.html`
- `009.html` through `020.html`: additional real pages selected during the
  low-rate Phase 2 run; exact URL, title, and structure statistics are in
  `huxiu-recon/phase2-samples.json`.

The original, separately retained recon captures are under
`huxiu-recon/`, together with `articles.json`, `discovery-analysis.json`, and
the A/B/C `benchmark.json` measurements.
